notes.title: Step Into Glorantha – Watch the Event, join the Beta, play at GenCon
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]As some of you know, yesterday we did a gameplay showcase event about RuneQuest: Warlords, our upcoming [b]turn-based strategy game[/b] set in the legendary world of Glorantha. During our special event, we revealed a lot about the game’s core features.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Strategy Game Rooted in Myth[/b][/h3][p]Based on the classic RPG RuneQuest (Chaosium, 1978), RuneQuest: Warlords brings players into a world where myth, magic, and conflict shape every battle. Our goal was to translate the spirit of the original RPG into a deep tactical experience, filled with heroic decisions, hero-led armies, and powerful Runes that influence fate itself. [/p][h3][b]Main Campaign: Defend Talastar[/b][/h3][p]The single-player campaign is set in Talastar, a borderland caught between the invading Lunar Empire and the corrupting forces of Chaos. You’ll follow Hahlgrim Ironsword, an Orlanthi warrior on a journey of justice and vengeance. The story unfolds over 18 missions across mythic landscapes and desperate conflicts. [/p][h3][b]Three Factions, Three Unique Playstyles[/b][/h3][p]Each faction offers a distinct tactical identity:[/p][list][*][p][b]Children of the Storm [/b](Talastar): fast, mobile, aggressive. Masters of terrain and initiative, empowered by the Runes of Air and Movement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lunar Empire[/b]: disciplined and coordinated. Quartz-armored legions, ritual mages, and formation-based tactics backed by the Moon Rune.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chaos[/b]: relentless, corruptive, regenerative. Mutating forces that grow stronger through death, drawing power from Chaos and Entropy.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Tactical Combat Powered by Runes[/b][/h3][p]Combat is grid-based and highly tactical, featuring Zones of Control, a flexible Action Points system, and the Battle Rush mechanic that rewards active play.[/p][p]Runes are at the heart of the game: each unit draws powers and identity from them, influencing abilities, synergies, and strategic options.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Skirmish & Multiplayer Modes[/b][/h3][p]Beyond the story campaign, RuneQuest: Warlords also includes Skirmish Mode: playable solo against the AI or in multiplayer PvP.[/p][p]Pick your faction and test your strategy in quick battles with high replay value.[/p][p][/p][p]Watch the full stream featuring live gameplay, team insights, and an exclusive mission preview:  [/p][previewyoutube="CbJ_k3Rv4Mc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]Join the closed beta![/b][/h2][p]The closed beta is now open, you still have the chance to sign up [url="https://www.slitherine.com/beta/runequest-warlords"]here[/url], and have a first look and the game and help us with your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]We’re heading to GenCon 2025![/b][/h2][p]We’ll be in [b]Indianapolis from July 31 to August 3[/b], attending GenCon for the full duration of the event,  and we’d love to meet you there.[/p][p]Whether you’re curious to learn more about [i]RuneQuest: Warlords[/i] or just want to stop by and say hi, you’ll find us ready to chat, answer your questions, and you’ll also have the chance to try an [b]exclusive hands-on demo[/b] featuring a selection of missions from the upcoming campaign.  If you’re around, don’t miss it — [b]come see us at GenCon.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]And.. don't forget to [b]wishlist[/b] the game:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2366500/RuneQuest_Warlords/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Hero Spotlight: Woowandor the Great Stag Rider

Our Hero Spotlight turns to the dark edges of Glorantha with the reveal of [b]Woowandor the Great Stag Rider[/b]. A chaotic scourge of the eastern frontier, Woowandor is the newest character sheet adapted from RuneQuest to RuneQuest: Warlords, our tactical turn-based strategy game. This broo warlord brings speed, ferocity, and corruption to the battlefield, embodying the raw, untamed violence of Dorastor’s most feared raiders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/7e97f13f1928a1cf221fa15054baa0c75a911031.jpg[/img]

Woowandor the Stag Rider is the elusive embodiment of Dorastor’s savagery. Cursed by many, this feared broo raider has earned his infamy through lightning-fast strikes and equally swift retreats. Throughout his reign as a warlord, none of his raids have been intercepted or caught off guard. In battle, Woowandor relies on the raw bestial strength of his warriors, the corruption of Chaos, and an utter disregard for his own losses.

notes.title: Dev Diary #3
notes.content:
[h3]What is RuneQuest: Warlords?[/h3]
RuneQuest: Warlords is a turn-based tactics game set in the enchanting world of RuneQuest, steeped in the culture of the Bronze Age where gods and mortals intertwine through magic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/d55e18960498b4e57d4cf055da7bc812a71db6b3.png[/img]

[h3]Warlords gameplay features[/h3]
[b]Turn-based combat[/b]
Engage in skirmish battles where players command their armies on grid-based maps. Players can maneuver their forces with precision, launching calculated attacks on enemy troops. Each move and decision can turn the tide of battle, making every encounter a test of wits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/4e803d3a6a7a16eaefc2ebd85d6d2c0d2431e928.png[/img]

[b]Army rosters[/b]
Assemble diverse and formidable armies by selecting units from your chosen faction to create a roster that matches your strategic vision. Each unit is equipped with unique weapons and magical abilities, offering a rich tapestry of options. Some units also provide different loadout choices, adding depth to your strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/6160a867e6ab25ab5e9bf02615ca3281d97fb9a4.png[/img]

[b]Momentum mechanics[/b]
Momentum adds a dynamic layer to the battlefield. This unique currency is earned through actions in battle or by following faction traits. When a unit reaches its Momentum cap, it unlocks powerful advantages: gaining an extra action point or activating empowered abilities. This system rewards tactical play and encourages continuous engagement, making each battle thrilling and immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/ff74c9f2926b777dd5be4aaee49876a7450fe355.png[/img]

[b]Faction trait bonuses[/b]
Each faction is designed with unique bonuses that enhance its playstyle. As units accumulate Momentum, these bonuses grow stronger, rewarding players for aligning with their faction's strategic flow. Talastar excels in active movement, gaining power and agility. The Lunar Empire thrives in formations, enhancing resilience and precision. Chaos grows fiercer with losses, harnessing unstable power through sacrifice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/44225e99981734485123c3cfc07d23e137f06890.png[/img]

[b]Various game modes[/b]
RuneQuest: Warlords offers a variety of game modes:
[list]
[*] Campaign Mode: Embark on an epic journey through 18 meticulously crafted missions set in the fantastical realm of Glorantha. Each mission unfolds a captivating story.
[*] Skirmish Mode: Test your strategies by replaying campaign missions with any chosen roster or face off against AI opponents on multiplayer maps. This mode provides endless replayability and opportunities to refine your tactics.
[*] Multiplayer Mode: Engage in thrilling battles against other players. Compete in intense matches with three distinct objectives and various maps where factions clash in epic battles.
[*] Hot Seat Mode: Experience local multiplayer by sharing the game on a single device with a friend, almost like having a fantasy chessboard.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/1c2555edb3ef7988a2afc277bad1f9bab95eec13.png[/img]

[h3]Ability kits[/h3]
Inspired by the rich lore of the RuneQuest setting, RuneQuest: Warlords features a vast array of magical abilities that stay true to the world’s tenets. Each unit boasts its own unique kit, reflecting their deep connection to the gods, their specialization, and their role on the battlefield.

[b]Wind Warp[/b]
High Priestesses manipulate the winds, accelerating friendly ranged attacks to deliver devastating strikes to enemies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/3f88095979d2ebb7ee8a25e52656358e9d0f4761.gif[/img]

[b]Flameblade[/b]
A common spell cast on sharp-bladed weapons, corrupted by Broo champions for more devastating effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/f26c1f558ceb1a61ff10ac96944feba9b5175389.gif[/img]

[b]Venomous Slash[/b]
Wyverns' tail slashes are deadly, with venom ensuring their attacks are exceedingly lethal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/88daa866d0494b648bb0caf545ffa5f39778b3dd.gif[/img]

[b]Thunderbolt[/b]
Exclusive to faction heroes, this ability allows worshippers of Orlanth to summon a devastating volt of lightning, turning the tide of battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/ef524c05b95d02802ed0485523548f66cdfb6ef2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dev Diary #2
notes.content:
The world of Glorantha is vast and immense, filled with countless epics of  heroism, struggle, and survival. When we set out to tell a new tale within this universe, we faced an overwhelming challenge: which of its many conflicts and cultures should we focus on? Glorantha is a land teeming with myth, war, and political intrigue, and narrowing our scope to a single region or faction was no small task.
We ultimately chose to focus on the Orlanthi, one of the most dynamic and numerous peoples in Glorantha. Their culture is rich with tradition, their pantheon brimming with gods of war, storm, and justice. But even within the Orlanthi, there are many different tribes and regions—Talastar, Aggar, the Empire of Saird, each with its own struggles and history. After much deliberation, we decided that Talastar best fit the themes we wanted to explore: resilience in the face of overwhelming odds, the struggle between tradition and change, and the ever-present threat of Chaos.

[h3]The Setting: A Land Under Siege[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/85d46dcb0ed2a69ef77c66d5f964f2aa9b5518d8.png[/img]
The Talastar Orlanthi are caught in a perilous situation. To the north looms the ever-expanding Lunar Empire, a behemoth of political and military might that seeks to assimilate or crush those who resist its influence. To the south, the twisted, Chaos-tainted Broo launch relentless raids, spreading disease and corruption wherever they tread. Even within Talastar itself, tribal rivalries and internal conflicts prevent a unified defense against these threats. It is a land in turmoil, where survival is not guaranteed and where heroes must rise to forge a future for their people.
It is in this brutal and unforgiving landscape that our story takes place—the saga of Hahlgrim Ironsword, a warrior whose legend will be shaped by the choices he makes and the trials he endures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/9ce8ecd597eab8d1a1448b62c0ae9fde82eae236.png[/img]

[h3]The Hero’s Journey[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/f02d188e73ec57fa21923fa6218267246199fda7.png[/img]
Hahlgrim begins his journey returning home, weary from past battles, only to find his land desecrated by Chaos. The attack is not random—it is part of a calculated series of brutal raids orchestrated by Woowandor, a fearsome and elusive Broo warlord. Vengeance becomes Hahlgrim’s driving force, but this is not merely a story of revenge—it is a tale of duty, honor, and the heavy burden of leadership.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/f96af96355db4c8236463e0573d94adcd2f3e481.png[/img]

His pursuit of Woowandor will take him deep into the dreaded land of Dorastor, a realm swallowed by Chaos, where reality itself bends and twists in unnatural ways. Along the way, Hahlgrim will encounter allies—other Orlanthi warriors, rival clans with their own agendas, and even unexpected figures from outside his people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/b49c7af187212c8705a9fbe9c42e24e100a9530d.png[/img]

[h3]Staying True to Glorantha’s Legacy[/h3]
In creating this story, we drew deeply from the established lore of Glorantha. Every decision—from the depiction of Talastar’s political struggles to the portrayal of figures like Hahlgrim, Woowandor, Ralzakark, and Hakon the Swimmer—was made with respect for the source material. These are not characters invented from thin air; they are figures who exist within the world of RuneQuest, and we aimed to honor their place in the timeline while weaving a compelling new narrative.

Adhering to Glorantha’s intricate history meant ensuring that our story did not contradict established events or create narrative paradoxes. We carefully studied the lore to maintain consistency, making sure that Hahlgrim’s actions align with the broader world and that his journey feels like a natural extension of Glorantha’s living history.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/77e9341cb530f6c70dd32031bba16a0774fc82d5.png[/img]
This is a story of survival, war, and the weight of destiny. Hahlgrim Ironsword’s journey is not just about slaying monsters or seeking vengeance—it is about what it means to be Orlanthi in an age of upheaval, where the very existence of his people is at stake. Every battle, every decision, and every alliance forged will shape the future of Talastar.
As we continue development, we look forward to sharing more insights into the game’s world, characters, and mechanics. Stay tuned for our next Dev Diary, where we will explore the deeper mechanics behind combat,  honor, and the influence of the gods in shaping fate on the field of battle.

notes.title: Dev diary #1
notes.content:
Welcome to the first Developer Diary for RuneQuest: Warlords. This is a game where gods intervene, warriors clash for survival, and every battle is a test of tactical mastery. Let’s dive into what makes Glorantha the perfect battlefield. 

[h3]Why Glorantha?[/h3]
Our choice of Glorantha, the legendary world crafted by Chaosium, was driven by its unique Bronze Age setting. Unlike traditional medieval or fantasy worlds, Glorantha is shaped by gods, driven by myth, and ruled by powerful factions locked in constant war. It’s a place where faith is as powerful as steel, and battlefields become arenas of divine intervention and strategic mastery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/3c75c5dd6dace328515cc28c5edb480aa33c3738.png[/img]

Glorantha is a world steeped in myth, where gods shape the land, magic is a force as real as metal, and every battle is part of a larger struggle for power and survival. It’s a world of warring factions, divine interventions, and legendary heroes, making it the perfect foundation for a deep and tactical war game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/6fdad45f7def55c1b63577bd0caa5c8e7b4cfcdd.png[/img]

Our goal is to capture the essence of Glorantha’s conflicts through turn-based battles that emphasize positioning, unit synergy, and battle mastery. Here you’ll wield god-given powers, rune magic, and divine blessings, which can quickly turn the tide of any battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/fdb003451f88f511a9a90e031338a8ed53d0720f.png[/img]

Whether commanding fierce Orlanthi warriors from Talastar, the disciplined legions of the Lunar Empire, or even savage hordes of Chaos, players will see each faction presented in its own unique and stylistic manner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/08969dfa73f8301547c677f4d5ba5b4d639f0a0c.png[/img]

In our work, we have remained true to the fundamental themes and creations lovingly crafted by the makers of RuneQuest. We took existing creatures and factions and sought to restore their faded splendor while preserving their uniqueness and staying faithful to their original vision.

[h3]What about our first campaign?[/h3]
Warlords of Glorantha is a story of tactical battles set in the harsh times of the Bronze Age. Armies clash under the banners of their gods, fighting for dominance and survival in the diverse world of Glorantha.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/1569687de0ac42262c15173fbf0b322a563e8234.png[/img]

Our story follows Hahlgrim, a Talastarian hero from the Bilings tribe, who ventures deep into the cursed Chaos-tainted forests of Dorastor to seek vengeance against the ruthless raider Woowandor, the one who shattered his homeland. 
But this is no ordinary battle. As Hahlgrim journeys deeper, he will face twisted Chaos beasts, corrupted warriors, and ancient horrors beyond imagination. Every battle is more than just survival - it’s a test of will, faith, and tactical mastery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340288/eb0df102995243bd77958c8596b32b82dc6b8e56.png[/img]

We eagerly look forward to sharing new details about the plot campaign and the latest updates on the development of RuneQuest: Warlords. 

Which would you lead into battle? The devoted Talastari sworn to Orlanth, the King God of Storms? The relentless  Broo under the terrifying Ralzakark, devoted to Chaos? Or the unbreakable legions of the Lunar Empire fighting for the Sun Emperor in the name of Red Goddess?

Let us know your choice in the comment and join the [url=https://discord.gg/wK55SVFU]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: RuneQuest: Warlords | Announcement news
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce our collaboration with Volmi - a Virtuos Studio, on an exciting new project: a tactical turn-based game that marks the first official video game adaptation of the iconic RPG, [b]RuneQuest[/b].

[b]RuneQuest: Warlords[/b] builds upon the core concepts of [b]Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector[/b] and elevates them to create a uniquely fresh experience for strategy fans.

[previewyoutube=7gNFN6iRtvs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Fantasy Turn-Based Battles in the Bronze Age [/b]
First created over 40 years ago and cherished by millions worldwide, the glorious fantasy RPG setting of [b]Glorantha [/b]provides a perfect backdrop for the turn-based tactical battles in RuneQuest: Warlords.

[b]A Battle for Survival [/b]
Players will take command of the [b]Talastar [/b]tribes, stepping into the role of warlords leading them through a gripping 18-mission single-player campaign. They will fight for survival against the relentless Chaos hordes, encountering iconic characters from the RuneQuest universe such as [b]Ketill White Eye, Hakon the Swimmer, Wovandor, and Ralzakark.[/b]

[b]Swords, Runes, and Sorcery[/b] 
The powerful spells of the Stormwalkers and the feral mounted charges of the Shadow Cats will determine the fate of the regions around the Sramake River, west of the famed Dragon Pass. The three factions in RuneQuest: Warlords - the Talastar, the Chaos Hordes, and the Lunar Empire - each offer unique strengths and distinct playstyles, with specialized and highly thematic units.

[b]Beyond the Campaign [/b]
In addition to the single-player campaign, the game features Skirmish mode and Multiplayer arenas. Players can choose their allegiance among the three factions, delving into the meticulously crafted and richly detailed lore of [b]RuneQuest[/b].
